text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
When I work at the library checkout 
counter, seeing all sorts of people borrow 
all sorts of books makes me so happy...♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"So this person likes this kind of book," 
or "Then they'd probably love that book 
too!" My imagination just ran wild...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um... I-I'm just imagining it! I'd 
never tell a soul! Who borrows what is 
strictly confidential, after all!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you please keep what we just 
talked about a secret from everyone 
else...?
